about.title: About Speed Duel GX: Duel Academy Box
paragraphs: Speed Duel GX: Duel Academy Box is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG pack released on 17 March 2022, in the SEVENS & GO RUSH!! era. It has 216 cards, and with the 23 other rarities there are 239 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 216 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 239, adding the 23 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
